text: ok so i still see the thing dragged out to the side. what should i do. obviously i could cut the model in half and mirror the good half but that is a lot of effort
resolution: Resolved the recovery approach without cutting/mirroring the whole vehicle: the stale damage is a 46-vertex car_body patch created by the former cross-owner mirror mapping, and it can be restored by one exact +0.392829 m X vertex move with Mirror Edit off. No detached part replacement is involved.
